sentences.text:
Author: Juvvadi Sridevi
Bench: Juvvadi Sridevi
 The Hon'Ble Smt. Justice Juvvadi Sridevi
 Writ Petition No.24588 of 2020
Order:

This writ petition, under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, is filed by the petitioner, wherein,
the following prayer is made.

"...be pleased to pass an order or orders or writ particularly one in the nature of a Writ Mandamus declaring the suspension order vide Proc.Rc.No.E/1862/2020,
dated 14.09.2020 issued by the 3rd respondent on the ground that a Criminal Case vide Crime No.399 of 2020 under Section 498A of IPC on the file of Suryapet II Town P.S. was registered, when no such case is registered against the petitioner nor the petitioner was arrayed as an accused in Crime/FIR No.399 of 2020, dated 23.08.2020 on the file of Suryapet II Town P.S. as arbitrary illegal, without jurisdiction, contrary to R.8(1) of TSCS(CCA) Rules, 1991 besides being violative of Article 14 & 21 of the Constitution of India and consequently set aside the same by granting all the consequential benefits that are entitled to the petitioner and pass such other order or orders..."
(reproduced verbatim)
2.

3. During the course of hearing, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Services-II produced a copy of the proceedings of the Director of Public Health and Family Welfare, Telangana, Hyderabad in Proc.Rc.No.9575/ND-A/2021, dated 12.04.2021 and submitted that pursuant to the interim order passed by this Court on 06.01.2021 in this writ petition, the suspension of the petitioner is revoked and she is posted at P.H.C. Kamepally, Khammam District pending disciplinary action.
4.
A perusal of the copy of the said proceedings reveals that the suspension of the petitioner was revoked and she was posted at P.H.C., Kamepally, Khammam District, pending disciplinary action.
Under these circumstances, nothing survives for adjudication in this writ petition.
5. Accordingly, the writ petition is dismissed as infructuous.
There shall be no order as to costs.
